reason: I'm not adding a bot to my work group where my staff talk about guests, villas and money, and I don't want it touching my Google account either. My admin already puts the transfers and receipts in a sheet, so I'd be paying $19 a month to take on a privacy risk for something that already gets done.
objection: It says it only takes payment documents and never writes in the group, but it still sits in the chat and can see everything. I have no way to check that, and I don't know who is behind it or where my data ends up.
would_change_my_mind: Letting me forward receipts to the bot privately, without adding it to the group or connecting my Google account, and getting the result as a file I download myself.
